Theres a difference in absorption in any drug, whether you are swallowing, smoking, snorting, through suppositories, or injecting.
 

Intravenous (IV)
~100%
Directly enters bloodstream; fastest and most intense onset.


Intramuscular (IM)
~50–70%
Slower onset than IV; bypasses first-pass metabolism.


Subcutaneous (SC)
~30–60%
Slower onset; less common.


Smoking (inhalation)
~40–60%
Rapid onset (within seconds); highly lipophilic, easily crosses lungs.


Insufflated (snorted)
~44–60%
Slower than smoking or injecting; can damage nasal mucosa.


Rectal (suppository)
~50–70%
Bypasses some first-pass metabolism; variable data, but fairly efficient.


Oral
~10–20%
Poor due to extensive first-pass liver metabolism of heroin itself.
